title: The Truth of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: The voice of the ancient existence echoed in the depths of Chen Ji's consciousness, ancient yet familiar—the summons that had never ceased in the Chen bloodline.

text.content: The crack in Heavenly Dao resembled a ferocious wound spanning across the void, its edges flowing with chaotic grayish-white energy streams. Chen Ji stopped before the fissure. Those eyes—those eyes that had never closed—were gazing at him from within the depths. What reflected in that pupil was neither stars nor sun and moon, but a void forgotten by time itself. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul convulsed violently within the Mental Sea, and Chen Ji felt an unprecedented terror spreading from that wisp of remnant spirit.

"You have finally come." The voice did not emanate from the eyes but resounded directly in the depths of Chen Ji's consciousness, ancient as if it had existed since the dawn of heaven and earth. "Chen bloodline, inheritor of the Tianji Record... I have waited for you far too long." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He instinctively tried to activate the Tianji Record Fragment to peer into the future, only to find the runes on the fragment dancing frantically, as if responding to something ancient.

dialogue.content: "Do not respond to it!" Mo Xiansheng's voice tore through the Mental Sea with desperate urgency. "Chen Ji, listen to me—the Tianji Record is not a divination tool, not a stroke of fortune—it is— it is a seal!" Chen Ji's body stiffened slightly. A seal? What seal? He suddenly realized Mo Xiansheng had been concealing something all along, or rather, he had been guided to discover this truth.

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng..." Chen Ji's voice echoed in the void. "How many more things have you hidden from me?" The void within those eyes seemed to smile. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long time, so long that Chen Ji thought he would never speak again. "The Tianji Record... is a chain." His voice finally emerged, carrying endless vicissitudes. "And you are part of that chain, or rather... part of the key."

The eyes within the Heavenly Dao crack blinked slowly, and in that instant, Chen Ji felt his entire Mental Sea trembling. The Tianji Record Fragment materialized before him unbidden, golden runes flowing like water, projecting a blurry image into the void—a chaotic battlefield where countless powerhouses had fallen, rivers of blood flowing everywhere. At the center of the battlefield, a colossal figure was bound by countless chains, each chain inscribed with the same runes as the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "In ancient times, there existed one who sought to devour the Heavenly Dao and take its place." The ancient voice spoke again, its calmness utterly chilling. "The powerhouses of all realms united to dismember and seal it away, and the Tianji Record... was merely one fragment of those chains." Chen Ji felt a chill crawl from his tailbone to the crown of his head. Fragment? The Tianji Record was a chain fragment sealing the ancient existence?

text.content: The image on the Fragment suddenly shifted. Chen Ji saw himself—no, not just himself, but Chen Nian as well. In one corner of that chaotic battlefield, a small figure was pierced through the chest by chains, those eyes identical to Chen Ji's. "The Chen family..." Chen Ji's breath turned ragged. "We are..." A hint of a smile appeared in that ancient voice: "You are the sacrifices of the seal, and the continuation of the chains."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's fists clenched tight, his knuckles whitening. Sacrifice? Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect for this so-called seal? His voice was low and dangerous: "Explain clearly." That voice seemed highly pleased with his reaction and continued slowly: "Every generation of Chen descendants is part of the seal. Your bloodline carries the power of the chains. And you... are the purest bloodline in a thousand years."

text.content: A flood of unfamiliar yet familiar images suddenly poured into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—he saw himself as a child touching an ancient Jade Pendant in the Chen family ancestral hall, saw his father speaking to him under the moonlight: "Chen descendants, the mission is passed down," saw the despair and relief in his father's eyes on the day Chen Nian was taken. These memories, which he had deliberately sealed away, now rushed forth like a breached dam. Chen Ji suddenly understood: the Chen family had not betrayed anyone, but had been maintaining this seal through generations of sacrifice.

"So the more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the weaker the seal grows." Chen Ji's voice was unexpectedly calm—that was the calm that only extreme fury could bring. "And my collection of Tianji Record Fragments, instead of making me stronger, has been亲手 releasing that existence." The ancient voice sighed softly: "You are very clever, cleverer than any inheritor before you. Unfortunately, you understand too late." The Heavenly Dao crack began to expand, those eyes drawing ever closer to Chen Ji.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul struggled violently within the Mental Sea. Finally, as if having made a crucial decision, he spoke: "Chen Ji, there is still a way. The seal cannot be completely undone, but it can be transferred—as long as you are willing." Chen Ji closed his eyes briefly. Transfer? Transfer to where? Mo Xiansheng's voice turned hoarse: "Transfer it to another person, such as... the Heavenly Dao Eye itself." The eyes within the Heavenly Dao crack suddenly contracted, as if something had been触动.

choice.prompt: Faced with this world-destroying truth, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Completely destroy the Tianji Record Fragment, cutting off any possibility of seal release. However, this means abandoning all ability to foresee the future, and unknown counterattacks may be triggered.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all abilities of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Completely sever any possibility of seal release
choices.risk_hint: The destruction process may trigger counterattacks, and the Heavenly Dao Eye will not stand by

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand. Golden runes danced upon his palm, as if sensing their master's intent and trembling with mournful wails. "The sacrifices of generations of Chen descendants..." Chen Ji's voice was soft. "Should not continue." His fingers tightened, spiritual energy surging. Under the activation, cracks began to appear on the Fragment.

choices.description: Neither destroy nor accept, but attempt to negotiate with the Heavenly Dao Eye, using the uniqueness of his bloodline to find a third path.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into an even greater conspiracy
choices.visible_reward: Retain abilities and possibly discover deeper truths
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao Eye will not yield easily, and the existence of a third solution itself is a trap
choices.process_label: attempt to bargain with heaven's eye

text.content: Chen Ji did not act immediately; instead, a cold smile curved his lips. "You say I'm the key, so... as a key, shouldn't I have the qualification to speak with the lock?" The eye in the gap of Heaven's Way slightly constricted, seemingly surprised by this reaction. Chen Ji continued, "What you want is liberation; what I want is... my sister's safety, and a truth."

choices.description: Form some kind of pact with the ancient existence, accepting its power, but this means becoming a betrayer of the seal, which could completely transform Chen Ji's essence.
choices.visible_cost: Risk Being Possessed by the Ancient Existence
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Complete Power Beyond the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The ancient existence's power is not free; every use deepens its influence.

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long time, and the虚无 in those eyes patiently waited for his answer. Finally, he smiled, that smile carrying a desperate resolve of breaking all bridges. "Alright." Just one word, yet it made Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emit a despairing wail. The gap of Heaven's Way suddenly expanded, and that eye revealed for the first time an emotion called "joy."

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, those eyes always watched him, as if observing prey finally fallen into a trap. "Do you think you have a choice?" That voice carried eternal coldness. "The choice a thousand years ago, the replay a thousand years later... The Chen family's bloodline has always been merely a chess piece in the game." Chen Ji felt a chill surge into his heart—chess piece? Could even rebellion itself be calculated within fate?

Just then, another voice suddenly rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea—that was Chen Nian's voice, young and terrified: "Brother... save me..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He perceived it—that was Chen Nian's distress signal from deep within the Holy Sect, and also the aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key he had been tracking. Her voice penetrated layers of prohibitions, reaching directly into his soul: "Brother don't... don't accept its power..."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's voice complicates the situation further; Chen Ji must re-examine his decision.

choices.description: Chen Nian's warning indicates a more urgent crisis than the Heavenly Dao's Eye; abandon the current confrontation with the ancient existence and immediately head to the Holy Sect.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the Current Opportunity That Could Change Destiny
choices.visible_reward: Protect the sister, gain more truth about the seal
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye may take action by taking this opportunity, and the Holy Sect surely has ambushes set up.
choices.process_label: decide to prioritize saving Chen Nian

text.content: Chen Ji turned abruptly, the hesitation in those eyes swept clean, replaced by icy resolve. "Chen Nian's matter is more important than any seal, any ancient existence." His voice was categorical, allowing no doubt. "What you want me to do, I refuse." The Tianji Record Fragment was stored in his Mental Sea, he urged his Spiritual Energy, his form transforming into a stream of light, galloping toward the Holy Sect's direction.

choices.text: Continue Facing the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.description: Since Chen Nian could send a message, it means she is temporarily safe; the current choice concerns everyone's fate and must not be shaken by personal emotions.
choices.visible_cost: Risk Forever Losing Chen Nian's Trust
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly resolve the seal problem and create a permanently safe environment for Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may be undergoing unimaginable pain, and her warning surely carries profound meaning.
choices.process_label: decide to continue facing heaven's eye

text.content: Chen Ji's form slightly stagnated; that call nearly made him lose control. But in the next second, he forced himself to calm down, sealing that voice in the depths of his Mental Sea. "Xiao Nian..." he whispered in his heart, "Wait for me, wait until I gain enough power, and I will definitely come to save you." His gaze fell on the gap of Heaven's Way again; the emptiness in those eyes seemed to mock his weakness.

However, the moment Chen Ji made his choice, the eyes in the gap of Heaven's Way suddenly laughed—not the playful smile from before, but a genuine, ecstatic laughter. "As expected... as expected..." That voice reverberated in Chen Ji's consciousness. "You think you're making a choice, but in truth, every one of your choices has been within my expectations. The Chen family's bloodline... truly the most perfect chess piece."

Chen Ji's footsteps suddenly stopped; he felt an unprecedented sense of crisis rising from the depths of his soul. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's words made him realize a terrifying possibility: whether accepting power, destroying the Tianji Record, or rescuing Chen Nian... these "choices" themselves might have been designed. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emitted a bitter laugh in his Mental Sea: "It speaks the truth; this is the nature of the Tianji Record... The ability to foresee the future is itself the chess game it has set up."

Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill; he suddenly understood something. The Tianji Record could foresee three hours into the future, and the Heavenly Dao's Eye... it has existed for hundreds of millions of years, what unit does its "foresight" use? In its eyes, is every one of Chen Ji's choices like a transparent chessboard? Yet, just as this despair was about to consume him, a thought flashed through— if it truly could foresee everything, why bother talking to him at all?

Chen Ji's eyes flashed with sharp light as he suddenly looked up, fixing his gaze on those fathomless eyes. "You're right, I may have been in your chess game all along." His voice suddenly became very soft and calm, "But there's one question... If I were truly just a piece, why would you still ask if I'm willing?" The smile within the Heavenly Secrets crack solidified, and for the first time, a trace of uncertainty flickered in those eyes.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji seized the crucial flaw and continued to probe the limits of the Heavenly Secrets Eye:

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Secrets Eye has reservations, continue to ask about things it cannot foresee, forcing it to reveal more information.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heavenly Secrets Eye and cause the situation to spiral out of control
choices.visible_reward: May discover the key to turning the chess game
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Secrets Eye's patience is limited, excessive interrogation may provoke a direct attack

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, and that oppressive pressure反而让his thoughts grew even clearer. "Since you can foresee everything, why do you fear a mortal's choice?" A hint of mockery tugged at the corner of his mouth, "You've spent so much effort setting up this chess game. And now, you're actually asking a piece to jump onto the board itself." The Heavenly Secrets crack trembled slightly, and for the first time, complex emotions emerged in those eyes.

choices.description: Don't tear the relationship apart, use the other party's reservations to negotiate more favorable conditions and gain true initiative for yourself.
choices.visible_cost: May be forced to make certain commitments
choices.visible_reward: May gain more information about the seal and Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Negotiation may be exploited, ultimately falling into deeper passivity

text.content: Chen Ji收起mocked的表情, replacing it with a thoughtful expression. "Fine, I'll temporarily believe you have reservations." He said slowly, "Then, we can discuss terms. I need to know the complete truth—about the Chen family, about the seal, about my sister." The emotions in those eyes gradually calmed, as if reassessing this human before them. The expansion of the Heavenly Secrets crack stopped.

Just then, a trembling voice from Mo Xiansheng suddenly rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying a sense of relief like a burden finally lifted: "Chen Ji... I can finally tell you everything." Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly as he felt Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul making some kind of decision. "The Tianji Record was created by me, but not for me." Mo Xiansheng's voice grew weaker, "It was my master's will... And my master is the ancient existence you speak of."

Chen Ji's breath hitched, and waves crashed in his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng... was a person of that ancient existence? No, impossible. If that were true, he couldn't have been guided by Mo Xiansheng all along. "Don't rush to conclusions." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a bitter tone, "I was once my master's most loyal guardian, but watching its madness, witnessing the tragic deaths of countless people... I regretted it. So I created the Tianji Record, giving the Chen bloodline a chance to choose."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul began to dissipate, those golden lights floating like fireflies in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "Now, I return the right of choice to you, my inheritor." His voice grew increasingly distant, "Trust no one's arrangements—not mine... not its... Your choice is the true variable." As the words fell, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul completely dissolved, transforming into scattered lights that merged into Chen Ji's soul.

Chen Ji stood quietly before the Heavenly Secrets crack, bearing the emptiness left by Mo Xiansheng's departure. He had gained much—fragments of Mo Xiansheng's memories, partial truth about the seal, and... an unshakable determination with no way back. After a long while, he lifted his head, stared directly at those eyes still watching him, and spoke calmly yet firmly: "I choose the third path." The eyes within the Heavenly Secrets crack slightly constricted as Chen Ji continued: "Not destruction, not acceptance, nor being manipulated by you."

"I will completely destroy this seal, but not in the way you expect." The Tianji Record Fragment materialized in Chen Ji's hand, golden runes intertwining with the residual light of Mo Xiansheng, "You said the Chen bloodline is part of the chain, so... what if the chain itself wants to break?" His voice carried a desperate madness, "Don't you want liberation? Then let me personally release you, and then—while you're at your weakest—end you completely."

The Heavenly Secrets crack shuddered violently, and for the first time, an emotion called "shock" appeared in those eyes, followed by anger, confusion, and finally... laughter. "Interesting..." The voice echoed in Chen Ji's consciousness, carrying an indescribably complex emotion, "For hundreds of millions of years, the first person to dare propose such a plan to me." Chen Ji felt an immense pressure descending from the heavens, almost crushing him, but he clenched his teeth and didn't retreat a single step.

"Good." The voice finally spoke again, this time carrying an emotion Chen Ji had never heard before—it was anticipation, "I agree to you, young Chen bloodline. Release me, and then... fight me." As the words fell, the Heavenly Secrets crack began to expand frantically, the void in those eyes transforming into a gray-white beam of light, shooting straight toward Chen Ji's brow center. Chen Ji did not dodge, because he knew this was the price of the covenant.

The gray-white radiance flooded into Chen Ji's spirit, resonating with the power sleeping within his bloodline. In an instant, he saw countless scenes—ancient war's ferocity, generations of Chen disciples' sacrifices, Chen Nian's pain as chains pierced through her, the conspiracy brewing within the Holy Sect... These images flickered through his consciousness like a carousel, finally focusing on a pair of eyes—his own eyes, but burning with ancient light that did not belong to humanity.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, the Heavenly Secrets crack had disappeared, replaced by a slowly rotating gray-white mark on his palm. The mark was like a seal, a covenant, and more like... a key. "Is this your wager?" Chen Ji looked down at the mark in his palm, a self-deprecating smile tugging at his mouth, "I thought it would be something more exciting." However, in the next second, a voice rang out in the depths of his consciousness—ancient and familiar, perfectly harmonizing with his own voice:

"Welcome, my inheritor... no, I should say—my other half."
